```{r}
# Plot diversity R/NR or sample_type for all kind of parameters
## NB : initially a loop on all parameters. Here only the unweighted and uniform=T parameter are selected

# Reload diversity list
div<-div_allIGH# Diversity of all IGH clones with Unweighted and Uniform=T and min_n=1000 parameters

# metadata at patient level
Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique_patient<-unique(Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique[,c("patient_id","R_NR")])
rownames(Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique_patient)<-Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique_patient$patient_id

# Reformat as patients_id data.frame (wider)
# div_patient<-lapply(div,function(sub_div){ # initially a list with 4 parameters. Here only 1

  # get diversity value
  # alpha_df <- sub_div@diversity # if raw results from alakazam function. Here this table is already obtained (see anonymisation)
  alpha_df <- div # only 1 table
  
  # get patient id and sample type for each sample
  alpha_df$patient_id <-gsub("_Tumor.*","",gsub("_PBMC.*","",alpha_df$sample_id))
  alpha_df$sample_type <-gsub(".*Tumor.*","Tumor",gsub(".*PBMC","PBMC",alpha_df$sample_id))
  
  # reshape wider by patient id
  alpha_df_wide <- pivot_wider(alpha_df,names_from = "sample_type",values_from = "d",id_cols =c("patient_id","q") )

  # compute T6/T0 and T6/Tumor fold change
  alpha_df_wide$FC_T6_on_T0 <- alpha_df_wide$PBMC_T6/alpha_df_wide$PBMC_T0
  alpha_df_wide$FC_T6_on_Tumor <- alpha_df_wide$PBMC_T6/alpha_df_wide$Tumor
  
  
  ## Merge back with metadata info
  alpha_df_wide<-merge(alpha_df_wide,Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique_patient,by="patient_id")

  ## convert q in a factor rather than a numeric for plot
  alpha_df_wide$q<-factor(alpha_df_wide$q)
  
  ## return patient level df
  # alpha_df_wide
# })

# now plot for each parameters used for estimation of alpha diversity
# var_to_iterate <- setNames(names(div_patient),names(div_patient))
var<-"Unweighted_UniformlyResampled"

# for(var in var_to_iterate){
  # retrive the patients lvl sample
  # hill_div <- div_patient[[var]] # if loop on 4 paramters
  hill_div <- alpha_df_wide#here only 1 parameter
  
  # create a melted na.omit df for raw value of diversity (paired test) / for FC
  hill_div_melt_raw <- reshape::melt.data.frame(hill_div[,setdiff(colnames(hill_div),c("FC_T6_on_T0", "FC_T6_on_Tumor"))],id.vars =c("patient_id" ,"q", "R_NR") )
  hill_div_melt_raw <- na.omit(hill_div_melt_raw)
  hill_div_melt_raw$variable<-factor(as.character(hill_div_melt_raw$variable),
                                 levels = c("Tumor","PBMC_T0", "PBMC_T6" , "PBMC_HD"))
  
  # FC
  hill_div_melt_FC <- reshape::melt.data.frame(hill_div[,setdiff(colnames(hill_div),c("Tumor","PBMC_T0", "PBMC_T6" , "PBMC_HD"))],id.vars =c("patient_id" ,"q", "R_NR") )
  hill_div_melt_FC <- na.omit(hill_div_melt_FC)
  hill_div_melt_FC$variable<-factor(as.character(hill_div_melt_FC$variable),
                                 levels = c("FC_T6_on_Tumor","FC_T6_on_T0"))
  
  ############################################################################
  ########## First : Plot FC and re-use previous script
  ############################################################################
  
  # diversity curve
  ## R vs NR
  ###log scale
  p<-ggplot(hill_div_melt_FC, aes(x = q, y = value, group = patient_id,color=R_NR)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color="black",linetype="dashed")+
    scale_color_manual(values = ColorPal$R_NR)+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaksLog10(),labels = prettyNum)+
    # stat_summary(aes(group = R_NR), fun = median,geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = R_NR),
                 fun = function(x) log10(median(10 ^ x)), # ADJUST IF LOG SCALE : order of mean/log
                 geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
    labs(title = "Alpha Diversity (Hill numbers) - Fold change after treatment per patient", x = "q", y = "Diversity fold change",
         subtitle = paste("IGH clone frequency",var))+  
    facet_wrap(~variable,scales = "free")+
    theme_minimal()
  
  ##### THIS IS Sup S9D (FC T6 on T0 correspond to S9D. left part)
  
  ggsave(plot = p,
         filename = paste0(res_folder,"S9D_Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_",var,"_FoldChange_DiversityCurves_compare_Response_logScale.pdf"),
         height = 5,width = 10)


    ######## T6 on T0 >>> THIS one is actually S9D (left)
  p<-ggplot(hill_div_melt_FC[hill_div_melt_FC$variable=="FC_T6_on_T0",], aes(x = q, y = value, group = patient_id,color=R_NR)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color="black",linetype="dashed")+
    scale_color_manual(values = ColorPal$R_NR)+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaksLog10(),labels = prettyNum)+
    # stat_summary(aes(group = R_NR), fun = median,geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = R_NR),
                 fun = function(x) log10(median(10 ^ x)), # ADJUST IF LOG SCALE : order of mean/log
                 geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
    labs(title = "Alpha Diversity (Hill numbers) - FC", x = "q", y = "Diversity fold change",
         subtitle = paste("IGH clone frequency",var))+  
    facet_wrap(~variable,scales = "free")+
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(plot = p,
         filename = paste0(res_folder,"S9D_Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_",var,"_FoldChange_DiversityCurves_compare_Response_logScale_T6onT0.pdf"),
         height = 4,width = 5)

  
  
  # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # 
  # boxplot at specific q
  # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # 
  
  # alpha_q0 <- filter(hill_div_melt_FC, q == 0)
  
  ## R vs NR
  p<-ggplot(hill_div_melt_FC, aes(x = R_NR, y = value,fill=R_NR)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color="black",linetype="dashed")+
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,outlier.colour = "grey")+
    scale_fill_manual(values = ColorPal$R_NR)+
    geom_point(size=0.5,position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75))+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaksLog10(),labels = prettyNum)+

    facet_grid(variable~q,scales = "free")+

  ## This is S9D right

         height = 8,width = 10)

    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color="black",linetype="dashed")+
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,outlier.colour = "grey")+

    # facet_grid(q~variable,scales = "free")+
    facet_grid(variable~q,scales = "free")+
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(plot = p,
         filename = paste0(res_folder,"S9D_Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_",var,"_FoldChange_BoxplotWithStat_AllQvalue_compare_Response_T6onT0.pdf"),
         height = 4,width = 9)
  
  
  ############################################################################
  ############################################################################
  ############################################################################
  ########## Plot FC but add stat comparison of AUC per patients 
  ############################################################################
  ############################################################################
  ############################################################################

  # get back a q value in continuous data to compute AUC (rather than factor for plot)
  hill_div_melt_FC$q<-as.numeric(as.character(hill_div_melt_FC$q))
  
  # compute AUC with MESS package on all q value ...
  auc_data <- hill_div_melt_FC %>%
      group_by(patient_id,variable, R_NR) %>%
      summarise(AUC = auc(q, value))
  
  ###Evaluate normality of distribution  Shapiro–Wilk test
  # Perform Shapiro-Wilk test for each treatment group
  shapiro_results <- auc_data %>%
    group_by(variable, R_NR) %>%
    summarise(p_value = shapiro.test(AUC)$p.value)
  normality_pass <- all(shapiro_results$p_value > 0.05)

  # wilcoxon test
  #T6_on_T0

  auc_test_T6_on_Tumor<-wilcox.test(AUC ~ R_NR, data = auc_test_T6_on_Tumor) #Test
  auc_test_T6_on_Tumor<-paste("wilcox.test on AUC\np-value =", format(auc_test_T6_on_Tumor$p.value, digits = 2, scientific = F))
  
  ### create a dummy df to plot p_value

    # geom_hline(yintercept = 0,color="black",linetype="dashed")+

         subtitle = paste("IGH clone frequency",var))+  
    facet_wrap(~variable,scales = "free")+
    theme_minimal()

    geom_line(aes(group = patient_id,color=R_NR),alpha = 0.3) +
    # geom_hline(yintercept = 0,color="black",linetype="dashed")+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color="black",linetype="dashed")+
    scale_color_manual(values = ColorPal$R_NR)+

    # scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1))+
    # stat_summary(aes(group = R_NR,color=R_NR), fun = median,geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = R_NR,color=R_NR),
                 fun = function(x) log10(median(10 ^ x)), # ADJUST IF LOG SCALE : order of mean/log
                 geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label=label),data = pval_df[pval_df$variable %in% "FC_T6_on_T0",])+
    labs(title = "Alpha Diversity (Hill numbers) - FC", x = "q", y = "Diversity Fold Change",
         subtitle = paste("IGH clone frequency",var))+  
    facet_wrap(~variable,scales = "free")+
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(plot = p,
         filename = paste0(res_folder,"S9D_Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_",var,"_FoldChange_BoxplotWithStat_AllQvalue_compare_Response_T6onT0_WithAUC_wilcoxTest.pdf"),
         height = 4,width = 5)
```

```{r}
    # get correct diversity

    hill_div <- div_ClassSwitch # Diversity of class switched IGH clones with Unweighted and Uniform=T and min_n=1000 parameters

    hill_div<-merge(hill_div,Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique[,c("sample_id","patient_id","sample_origin","sample_timepoint","sample_type","sample_type2","R_NR")],by="sample_id")
    
    ## convert q in a factor rather than a numeric for plot
    hill_div$q<-factor(hill_div$q)
    
    ########    ########    ########    ########    ########
    # I - GLOBAL diversity curve
    ########    ########    ########    ########    ########
    ## Ia- sample_type global 
    
    ### Compute number of sample in the corresponding filter/parameter

    num_samples<-data.frame(num_samples)
    num_samples <- num_samples[num_samples$Freq !=0,] # remove lines without any samples
    final_label <- paste(paste("Tumor:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "Tumor.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.T0:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.T6:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T6"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.HD:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.HD"],collapse = ", ")),
                         sep = " ; ")
  
    #### after removing PBMC HD
    
    ### diversity curve
    p<-ggplot(hill_div[!grepl("HD",hill_div$sample_id),], aes(x = q, y = d,color=sample_type2)) + # reomve HD
      geom_line(aes(group = sample_id),alpha = 0.3) +
      stat_summary(aes(group = sample_type2), fun = median, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = ColorPal$sample_type2)+
      stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif",size=3.5)+
      # stat_compare_means(size=3.5)+
      labs(title = "Diversity of class-switched IGH", x = "q", y = "Diversity (class-switched IGH)",
           subtitle = gsub("...PBMC.HD:..","",final_label), # reomve HD
           color="sample_type",
           caption = paste(minN,"sequences, ",var))+  
        theme_classic()
    
    # THIS IS SUP S10A left
    ggsave(plot = p,
           filename = paste0(res_folder,"S10A_Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_ClassSwitchedIGH_",minN,"_",var,"_DiversityCurves_Compare_SampleType_RemoveHD.pdf"),
           height = 5,width = 7)
    
   
    
    ########    ########    ########    ########    ######## ################################
    # Abundance of clones
    ########    ########    ########    ########    ######## ################################

    # Get correct clone_frequency according to variables in the loop
    # clone_frequency <- abund_list[[minN]][[var]]@abundance
    clone_frequency <- abund_ClassSwitch # Abundance of class switched IGH clones with Unweighted and Uniform=T and min_n=1000 parameters
    
    ## Merge back with metadata info
    clone_frequency<-merge(clone_frequency,Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique[,c("sample_id","patient_id","sample_origin","sample_timepoint","sample_type","sample_type2","R_NR")],by="sample_id")

    ### Compute number of sample in the corresponding filter/parameter
    clone_frequency$rank_character<-as.character(clone_frequency$rank)
    
    ###### number of samples split by R_NR group
    num_samples <- table(clone_frequency[clone_frequency$rank_character =="1",c("R_NR","sample_type")])
    num_samples<-data.frame(num_samples)
    num_samples <- num_samples[num_samples$Freq !=0,] # remove lines without any samples
    num_samples$label <- paste(num_samples$Freq,num_samples$R_NR,sep = "-") # paste n and R_NR group
    final_label_R_NR <- paste(paste("Tumor:",paste(num_samples$label[num_samples$sample_type %in% "Tumor.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.T0:",paste(num_samples$label[num_samples$sample_type %in% "PBMC.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.T6:",paste(num_samples$label[num_samples$sample_type %in% "PBMC.T6"],collapse = ", ")),
                         sep = " ; ")
    
    ###### number of samples overall (only by sample type)
    num_samples <- table(clone_frequency[clone_frequency$rank_character =="1",c("sample_type2")])
    num_samples<-data.frame(num_samples)
    num_samples <- num_samples[num_samples$Freq !=0,] # remove lines without any samples
    final_label_SampleType <- paste(paste("Tumor:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "Tumor.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.T0:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.T6:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T6"],collapse = ", ")),
                         paste("PBMC.HD:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.HD"],collapse = ", ")),
                         sep = " ; ")
      
      
    ###########################################################################
    # Top clones
    ###########################################################################
    ## top 10
    clone_frequency_top10<-clone_frequency
    clone_frequency_top10$rank_character<-as.character(clone_frequency_top10$rank)
    clone_frequency_top10 <- clone_frequency_top10[clone_frequency_top10$rank_character %in% as.character(1:10),]#filter top 10
    clone_frequency_top10$rank_character <- factor(clone_frequency_top10$rank_character,levels = as.character(1:10)) # as factor
    
    ##  without HD PBMC
    p<-ggplot(clone_frequency_top10[!grepl("HD",clone_frequency_top10$sample_id),],aes(x =rank_character,y= p,fill=sample_type2))+ # remove HD
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,outlier.colour = "grey")+
      geom_point(size=0.4,position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75),color="darkgrey")+
      scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaksLog10(),labels = prettyNum)+
      scale_fill_manual(values = ColorPal$sample_type2)+
      # facet_grid(.~R_NR,scales = "free_x",space = "free_x")+
      stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif")+
      theme_classic()+
      # theme(legend.position = "none")+
      labs(y="Clone frequency of class-switched IGH",
           title = "Rank clone abundance of class-switched IGH - Top 10 clones",
           x="Rank of top 10 clones",
           subtitle = gsub("...PBMC.HD...","",final_label_SampleType), # remove HD
           fill="sample_type",
           caption = paste(minN,"sequences, ",var))
    
    ### THIS IS SUP S10A right
    ggsave(plot = p,
           filename = paste0(res_folder,"S10A_Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_ClassSwitchedIGH_",minN,"_",var,"_Top10clone_compare_SampleType_RemoveHD.pdf"),
```

```{r}
       hill_div <- div_list[[iso]] # Diversity of IgGs or IgAs clones with Unweighted and Uniform=T and min_n=500 parameters
  

      ## Merge back with metadata info
      hill_div<-merge(hill_div,Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique[,c("sample_id","patient_id","sample_origin","sample_timepoint","sample_type","sample_type2","R_NR")],by="sample_id")
      
      ## convert q in a factor rather than a numeric for plot
      hill_div$q<-factor(hill_div$q)

      ########    ########    ########    ########    ########

      num_samples <- table(hill_div[hill_div$q =="0",c("sample_type2")])
      num_samples<-data.frame(num_samples)
      num_samples <- num_samples[num_samples$Freq !=0,] # remove lines without any samples
      final_label <- paste(paste("Tumor:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "Tumor.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.T0:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.T6:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T6"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.HD:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.HD"],collapse = ", ")),
                           sep = " ; ")
     
      ####  after removing PBMC HD
      
      ### diversity curve
      p<-ggplot(hill_div[!grepl("HD",hill_div$sample_id),], aes(x = q, y = d,color=sample_type2)) + # reomve HD
        geom_line(aes(group = sample_id),alpha = 0.3) +
        stat_summary(aes(group = sample_type2), fun = median, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = ColorPal$sample_type2)+
        stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif",size=3.5)+
        # stat_compare_means(size=3.5)+
        labs(title = paste("Diversity of",iso,"clones"), x = "q", y = paste("Diversity of",iso),
             subtitle = gsub("...PBMC.HD:..","",final_label), # reomve HD
             color="sample_type",
             caption = paste(minN,"sequences, ",var))+  
          theme_classic()
      
      ### This is SUP S10B or S10C left (depending on isotype)
      prefixe <- ifelse(iso=="IgGs",yes = "S10B_",no = "S10C_")
      ggsave(plot = p,
             filename = paste0(res_folder,prefixe,"Immcantation_AlphaDiversity_All_",iso,"_",minN,"_",var,"_DiversityCurves_Compare_SampleType_RemoveHD.pdf"),
             height = 5,width = 7)
      
      
      ########    ########    ########    ########    ######## ################################
      # Abundance of clones

      # Get correct clone_frequency according to variables in the loop
      # clone_frequency <- abund_list[[minN]][[iso]][[var]]@abundance ### Add the isotye level in list
      clone_frequency <- abund_list[[iso]] # Abundance of IgGs or IgAs clones with Unweighted and Uniform=T and min_n=500 parameters
      
      ## Merge back with metadata info
      clone_frequency<-merge(clone_frequency,Immcantation_meta_ICI_unique[,c("sample_id","patient_id","sample_origin","sample_timepoint","sample_type","sample_type2","R_NR")],by="sample_id")

      num_samples<-data.frame(num_samples)
      num_samples <- num_samples[num_samples$Freq !=0,] # remove lines without any samples
      num_samples$label <- paste(num_samples$Freq,num_samples$R_NR,sep = "-") # paste n and R_NR group
      final_label_R_NR <- paste(paste("Tumor:",paste(num_samples$label[num_samples$sample_type %in% "Tumor.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.T0:",paste(num_samples$label[num_samples$sample_type %in% "PBMC.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.T6:",paste(num_samples$label[num_samples$sample_type %in% "PBMC.T6"],collapse = ", ")),
                           sep = " ; ")
      
      ###### number of samples overall (only by sample type)
      num_samples <- table(clone_frequency[clone_frequency$rank_character =="1",c("sample_type2")])
      num_samples<-data.frame(num_samples)
      num_samples <- num_samples[num_samples$Freq !=0,] # remove lines without any samples
      final_label_SampleType <- paste(paste("Tumor:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "Tumor.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.T0:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T0"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.T6:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.T6"],collapse = ", ")),
                           paste("PBMC.HD:",paste(num_samples$Freq[num_samples$Var1 %in% "PBMC.HD"],collapse = ", ")),
                           sep = " ; ")
        
        
      ###########################################################################
      # Top clones
      ###########################################################################
      ## top 10
      clone_frequency_top10<-clone_frequency
      clone_frequency_top10$rank_character<-as.character(clone_frequency_top10$rank)
      clone_frequency_top10 <- clone_frequency_top10[clone_frequency_top10$rank_character %in% as.character(1:10),]#filter top 10
      clone_frequency_top10$rank_character <- factor(clone_frequency_top10$rank_character,levels = as.character(1:10)) # as factor

      ## without HD PBMC
      p<-ggplot(clone_frequency_top10[!grepl("HD",clone_frequency_top10$sample_id),],aes(x =rank_character,y= p,fill=sample_type2))+ # remove HD
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,outlier.colour = "grey")+
        geom_point(size=0.4,position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75),color="darkgrey")+
        scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaksLog10(),labels = prettyNum)+

        stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif")+

        # theme(legend.position = "none")+
        labs(y=paste("Clone frequency of",iso),
             title = paste("Rank clone abundance of",iso," - Top 10 clones"),
             x="Rank of top 10 clones",
             subtitle = gsub("...PBMC.HD...","",final_label_SampleType), # remove HD
             fill="sample_type",
             caption = paste(minN,"sequences, ",var))
      
      ### This is SUP S10B or S10C right (depending on isotype)
      prefixe <- ifelse(iso=="IgGs",yes = "S10B_",no = "S10C_")
```
